purpose: Prove, rather than assume, whether System Master foundational mapping, tracing, ownership and execution semantics are complete.
scope: all canonical foundational requirements and capability crosswalk entries including C00-C49 and P00-P15
all first-class and headless capability ownership decisions
all command, query, API, event and error routes
transaction, concurrency, idempotency, cache, invalidation and sync semantics where applicable
authority, privacy, native, human and external dependency boundaries
evidence/provenance, completion, obligation and expectation bindings
failure, retry, timeout, rollback and recovery behavior
tests, benchmarks, static/dynamic checks and failure-injection obligations
build, release, deployment, operations, maintenance and documentation foundation obligations
closure_rule: Foundation 1.0 may be called complete only when every in-scope row is COMPLETE_WITH_EVIDENCE or EXPLICITLY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_WITH_AUTHORITY, and every durable blocker is separately recorded as preventing only the dependent capability rather than silently closing unrelated work.
no_silent_gap_rule: Missing owner, route, contract, canonical writer, authority boundary, failure semantics, evidence target or acceptance target is an ACTIVE_GAP, not completion.
evidence_rule: COMPLETE_WITH_EVIDENCE requires an explicit Foundation evidence receipt bound to CURRENT-AUTHORITY, canonical owner, and exact Git blob identities of the qualified subject files. Populated contract prose alone is never acceptance evidence. Evidence subject drift invalidates PASS.
ownership_rule: Crosswalk ownership and the current owner-allocation registry must agree for every owned capability; disagreement is a census failure, not a tie-breaker.
blocker_rule: External, human, private or native blockers may be recorded only after all repository-solvable contract, ownership, authority-boundary and evidence obligations for that row are complete; a blocker may not conceal local unfinished work.
execution_rule: Each ACTIVE_GAP must be assigned to its canonical owner and converted into the highest-value dependency-valid safe successor packet. Platform/foundation prerequisites are considered before product capabilities; explicit dependency evidence overrides identifier order.
forbidden_claims: do not infer completion from prior planning volume
do not fabricate ownership, authority or evidence
do not treat a stale/absent delegation as an empty valid lane
do not transfer hosted evidence into A-01/native/private/publication/production authority
do not treat populated contract prose as acceptance evidence
do not transfer PASS when an exact qualified subject blob has changed
do not use an external/native/private blocker to hide unfinished repository-solvable work
final_artifact: A 100-percent disposition matrix containing every required column, plus unresolved-gap successor register, evidence pointers, and Foundation 1.0 closure decision.
